ModMetaData.name: CCTO for VPE（CCTO VPE対応）
ModMetaData.author: sucRo0629
ModMetaData.description:
CCTO for VPE applies individual minimum growth temperatures and cold-death temperatures or cold dormancy to 20 plants from Vanilla Plants Expanded 1.6. This is an XML compatibility addon for Crop Cold Tolerance Overhaul. It preserves VPE plant classes, yields, recipes, and graphics. RimWorld 1.6 only. Requires CCTO and VPE. Not independently tested in a running game; user bug reports are welcome: https://github.com/sucRo-RimWorld/CCTO-for-VPE/issues . VPE add-on plant packs are not yet supported. Existing-save addition/removal has not been tested in-game.
CCTO for VPEは、Vanilla Plants Expanded 1.6の植物20種に最低生育温度・枯死温度または低温休眠を個別設定するCCTO用XML互換Mod。VPE固有の植物クラス・収穫量・レシピ・画像は変更しない。RimWorld 1.6専用でCCTOとVPEが必須。実ゲーム未検証。既存セーブへの追加・削除も実ゲーム未検証。利用者からの不具合報告を受け付ける：https://github.com/sucRo-RimWorld/CCTO-for-VPE/issues 。VPE追加植物パックは未対応。
